remarks: This stunning 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom unit with a BRAND NEW HVAC System is located at the highly desirable Eastside Commons. Featuring 9-foot ceilings and large sunlit windows, the unit showcases new wood floors in the open-plan living area, with access to the balcony from both the living room and primary bedroom. Upon entry, you are welcomed by a spacious kitchen equipped with stainless steel GE Profile appliances, granite countertops, and a sizable island offering ample storage space. The primary bedroom includes a luxurious en suite bathroom and a sizable walk-in closet. The second bedroom also boasts a generous walk-in closet and is conveniently located across from another full bathroom in the hallway. For added convenience, the unit comes with a full-size washer and dryer. Residents can take advantage of a variety of exceptional amenities within the building, such as a fitness center, a large courtyard with gas grills and comfortable seating, and garage parking with two elevator access points. The property is conveniently located just a short distance from I-95, downtown Stamford, and the Stamford Metro North/Amtrak train station, providing excellent access to transportation and urban amenities. The assigned garage space is located directly off the elevator, with additional parking available in any unassigned spaces.
